info.name: RoomMate Hub API
info.description:
Housing & Roommate Platform API. Phase 1: 42 endpoints.

Every response uses { success, statusCode, message, data | errors }. Protected routes need `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

Run everything with `bun run test:api` (local) or `bun run test:api:prod` (live). Passwords come from your .env and are never stored in this file.

item.name: 00 Setup
item.description: Logs in the seeded demo accounts and prepares run values.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: E01–E06: register, login, Google, refresh rotation, logout.

exec: pm.test("Message: User Registered Successfully", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("User Registered Successfully"));

pm.test("Message: Email Already Registered", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Email Already Registered"));
pm.test("Message: Invalid Email Or Password", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid Email Or Password"));

item.name: 07 Stripe checkout and tenancy (needs Stripe test keys)
item.description: Runs only when real Stripe test keys are in .env. Creates a real Checkout Session, then sends a signed checkout.session.completed event (as Stripe would after payment), and continues with the tenancy lifecycle.

item.name: E26 Checkout again reuses the session

exec: pm.test("Message: Checkout Session Already Open", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Checkout Session Already Open"));

const payload = JSON.stringify({ id: "evt_test_" + Date.now(), object: "event", type: "checkout.session.completed", data: { object: { id: "cs_test_postman", object: "checkout.session", payment_status: "paid", payment_intent: "pi_test_" + pm.environment.get("paymentId").replace(/-/g, ""), metadata: { paymentId: pm.environment.get("paymentId") } } } });
